raw:
# COMPLETE TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION FOR RENZO PHASE 1

APP: Renzo - AI Relationship Outreach Platform
OVERVIEW: Renzo is a premium B2B relationship management tool that helps sales reps and procurement teams maintain consistent contact with their network. It uses AI to generate contextually-aware outreach messages based on comprehensive relationship history, ensuring every touchpoint is timely, relevant, and personalized.

---

## VIEWS

### LoginView
Purpose: Authentication gate before accessing the application
Elements: Centered card container, Renzo wordmark/logo, tagline text "Relationships that remember", username input field, password input field, login button, inline error message div (hidden by default)
Interactions: Type in username field, type in password field, click login button, press Enter key in either field to submit, see error message if credentials wrong, transition to onboarding or dashboard on success

### OnboardingView
Purpose: One-time setup to capture company context for AI personalization
Elements: Modal/centered card with close/skip button, heading "Tell us about your business", company name input, what you sell textarea (placeholder: "Describe your products/services in 2-3 sentences"), typical customer textarea (placeholder: "Who are they? What do they care about?"), communication tone dropdown (options: Professional, Conversational, Direct, Warm), rep name input (who messages come from), save button, skip button
Interactions: Fill out all fields, select tone from dropdown, click save to store and proceed, click skip to dismiss and go to dashboard, show validation errors if save clicked with empty required fields

### DashboardView
Purpose: Overview of relationship health and immediate action items
Elements: Greeting header with time-based salutation and rep name, current date display in secondary text, four stat cards in grid (Total Contacts count, Due Today count, Overdue count, Sent This Week count), "Due Today" section header, list of due contacts (each row: contact name, company, tier badge, days overdue indicator, "Generate Message" button), Recent Activity feed section header, activity log list (each entry: timestamp, contact name, action type, message preview), empty states for both lists when no data
Interactions: View all stats at a glance, click "Generate Message" on any due contact to open AI generation modal, scroll through activity feed, click contact name in due list to view contact detail

### ContactsView
Purpose: Browse, search, and manage all contacts
Elements: Page header "Contacts", search input (placeholder: "Search by name or company"), tier filter dropdown (All Tiers, A-Tier, B-Tier, C-Tier), status filter dropdown (All, Overdue, Due Soon, On Track), "Add Contact" button (top right, green), contacts table with columns (Name, Company, Tier badge, Last Contact date, Next Due date, Status pill, Actions icon), empty state message ("No contacts yet. Add your first contact to start building relationships."), pagination controls if over 50 contacts
Interactions: Type in search to filter table, select tier filter to show only A/B/C contacts, select status filter to show overdue/due soon/on track, click "Add Contact" to open add form, click any table row to view contact detail, click actions icon for quick actions menu (Edit, Delete, Generate Message)

### AddContactForm (Modal/Overlay)
Purpose: Create new contact with all relationship context
Elements: Modal overlay with white card, header "Add New Contact", close X button, Full Name input (required), Company input (required), Title/Role input, Email input (type=email), Phone input (type=tel), Tier dropdown (required, with helper text - A: Weekly, B: Monthly, C: Quarterly), Touch Frequency number input (days, auto-filled based on tier), Last Contact Date input (type=date), Location/Region input, Account Size dropdown (Small, Mid-Market, Large, Enterprise), Products/Services They Use textarea (3 rows), Relationship History textarea (5 rows, placeholder: "Past conversations, key topics discussed, who has spoken with them..."), Notes textarea (3 rows), Save button (green), Cancel button (gray)
Interactions: Fill out form fields, tier selection auto-populates touch frequency, click Save to validate and store contact, click Cancel to close without saving, see inline validation errors on required fields, close modal on successful save

### EditContactForm (Modal/Overlay)
Purpose: Update existing contact information
Elements: Identical to AddContactForm but header says "Edit Contact", all fields pre-populated with existing contact data, Save button updates instead of creates, additional Delete button in footer (red, left-aligned)
Interactions: Modify any field, click Save to update contact, click Cancel to discard changes, click Delete to remove contact with confirmation prompt

### ContactDetailView (Modal/Overlay)
Purpose: View complete contact information and activity history
Elements: Modal overlay with white card, contact name header with company subtitle, close X button, tier badge and status pill, grid of contact details (all fields from contact object displayed in read-only format with labels), "Edit Contact" button, "Generate Message" button, "Activity History" section with list of all messages sent to this contact (timestamp, message preview, reason, expand/collapse), "Back to Contacts" button
Interactions: Read all contact information, click "Edit Contact" to open edit form, click "Generate Message" to open AI generation, click activity items to expand full message, click close or back to return to contacts list

### AIGenerationModal
Purpose: Generate contextual AI message and show reasoning
Elements: Modal overlay with white card, header "Generating Message for [Contact Name]", loading state with spinner and text "Analyzing relationship context...", result state with two sections: "Why This Message" info box (light green tint, contains AI reasoning 2-3 sentences), message textarea (editable, contains generated message), button row (Add to Queue green button, Regenerate gray button, Cancel gray button), error state if API fails (red banner with error message and Retry button)
Interactions: Wait during loading, read AI reasoning, edit message text if needed, click "Add to Queue" to save and close, click "Regenerate" to call API again with same context, click "Cancel" to close without saving, click "Retry" if error occurred

### OutreachQueueView
Purpose: Manage approved messages ready to send
Elements: Page header "Outreach Queue" with count badge, "Mark All Sent" button (top right), queue items list (each item: contact name and company, tier badge, timestamp added, reason summary with expand arrow, message preview - first 80 chars with "..." , action buttons row: "Mark Sent" green button, "Edit" gray button, "Remove" gray/red text button), empty state ("Your queue is clear. Generate messages from your contacts to get started.")
Interactions: Click expand arrow to see full reason, click "Mark Sent" to log activity and remove from queue, click "Edit" to open message in modal for editing, click "Remove" to delete from queue with confirmation, click "Mark All Sent" to bulk process all items with confirmation dialog

### DraftsView
Purpose: View messages not yet approved for queue
Elements: Page header "Drafts" with count badge, drafts items list (same layout as queue items but different labels: "Move to Queue" instead of "Mark Sent", "Delete Draft" instead of "Remove"), empty state ("No drafts. Messages you skip or save for later will appear here.")
Interactions: Click "Move to Queue" to transfer item from drafts to queue, click "Edit" to modify message, click "Delete Draft" to remove permanently with confirmation, expand/collapse to see reasoning

### SettingsView
Purpose: Configure API key and company profile
Elements: Page header "Settings", warning banner at top if no API key set (yellow background, "Please add your Anthropic API key to enable AI message generation"), "API Configuration" section with Anthropic API Key input (type=password, toggle show/hide button), "Test Connection" button, connection status indicator (hidden until test clicked), "Company Profile" section with all onboarding fields (company name, what you sell, typical customer, tone dropdown, rep name), "Account Information" section showing username in read-only format, "Save Settings" button (green, bottom right), success message (green, temporary, "Settings saved successfully"), error message area for API test failures
Interactions: Paste API key, click toggle to show/hide key, click "Test Connection" to verify key works, edit company profile fields, click "Save Settings" to persist all changes to localStorage, see success confirmation message that fades after 3 seconds

### SidebarNavigation
Purpose: Primary navigation and user context
Elements: Sidebar container (dark background #1A1A1A), Renzo wordmark at top in brand green, navigation menu with 5 items (Dashboard with home icon, Contacts with people icon, Outreach Queue with paper plane icon, Drafts with document icon, Settings with gear icon), active item has green background highlight and white text, bottom section with divider line, logged-in username display, Logout button
Interactions: Click any nav item to switch views, active item remains highlighted, click Logout to clear session and return to login, hover states on all nav items (slight lightening)

---

## FUNCTIONS

### Authentication & Session Management

- **init()**: Entry point, called on DOMContentLoaded. Checks localStorage for renzo_session. If session exists, calls loadUserSession(). If not, shows LoginView. Loads API key from localStorage into RENZO_API_KEY global variable. Attaches all event listeners for login form. Sets up sidebar navigation listeners.

- **handleLogin(event)**: Prevents default form submission. Gets username and password values. Trims whitespace. Checks if username === 'admin' && password === 'renzo2024'. If valid, creates session object {username: 'admin', loginTime: Date.now(), repName: 'Admin'}, saves to localStorage as renzo_session, calls checkOnboardingStatus(). If invalid, displays inline error "Invalid username or password" in red below form for 3 seconds then clears.

- **handleEnterKey(event)**: Listens for Enter key (event.key === 'Enter') in login form inputs. If pressed, calls handleLogin().

- **loadUserSession()**: Retrieves renzo_session from localStorage. Parses JSON. Sets global currentUser variable. Calls checkOnboardingStatus().

- **checkOnboardingStatus()**: Checks localStorage for renzo_onboarded boolean. If false or not exists, shows OnboardingView. If true, loads company profile data and calls showDashboard().

- **logout()**: Shows confirmation dialog "Are you sure you want to logout?". If confirmed, clears renzo_session from localStorage. Resets currentUser global to null. Hides all views. Shows LoginView. Clears any sensitive data from memory.

### Onboarding

- **handleOnboardingSave()**: Gets values from all onboarding form fields (companyName, whatYouSell, typicalCustomer, commTone, repName). Validates required fields are not empty. Trims all text inputs. Creates companyProfile object with all fields. Saves to localStorage as renzo_company_profile. Sets renzo_onboarded to true in localStorage. Updates currentUser.repName with entered repName. Saves updated session. Calls showDashboard(). Shows success message briefly.

- **handleOnboardingSkip()**: Sets renzo_onboarded to true without saving profile. Calls showDashboard(). Stores empty/default company profile for later editing.

### View Management

- **showView(viewName)**: Hides all views by adding .hidden class to every view element. Removes .hidden from specified viewName element. Updates sidebar active state by removing active class from all nav items and adding to clicked item. Calls view-specific load function if exists (showDashboard calls loadDashboardData, showContacts calls loadContactsTable, etc).

- **showDashboard()**: Calls showView('dashboard'). Calls loadDashboardData(). Sets greeting header text based on time of day (getGreeting() + currentUser.repName). Sets date display to formatted current date.

- **loadDashboardData()**: Retrieves all contacts from localStorage. Calculates stats: totalContacts = contacts.length, calculates dueToday by comparing nextDueDate to today, calculates overdue by checking if nextDueDate < today, retrieves activity log and filters for current week to get sentThisWeek count. Updates stat card displays. Calls buildDueContactsList(). Calls buildRecentActivity(). Handles empty states if no data.

- **getGreeting()**: Gets current hour. Returns "Good morning" if hour < 12, "Good afternoon" if hour < 18, else "Good evening".

- **buildDueContactsList(contacts)**: Filters contacts array where nextDueDate <= today. Sorts by overdue days (most overdue first). Iterates through filtered list. For each contact, creates HTML row with contact name, company, tier badge (colored and labeled), days overdue calculation (today - nextDueDate), "Generate Message" button with data-contact-id attribute. Appends to due contacts container. If empty, shows "All caught up! No contacts due today." message.

- **buildRecentActivity()**: Retrieves renzo_activity from localStorage. Sorts by timestamp descending (newest first). Takes first 10 items. For each activity, creates HTML entry with formatted timestamp (formatDateTime), contact name as clickable link, action description, truncated message preview (first 60 chars). Appends to activity feed container. If empty, shows "No recent activity." message.

- **showContacts()**: Calls showView('contacts'). Calls loadContactsTable() with no filters. Sets up search input listener (debounced 300ms). Sets up tier filter listener. Sets up status filter listener. Sets up "Add Contact" button listener.

- **loadContactsTable(searchTerm = '', tierFilter = '', statusFilter = '')**: Retrieves all contacts from localStorage. Applies filters: if searchTerm, filters where contact name or company includes searchTerm (case insensitive). If tierFilter, filters where contact.tier === tierFilter. If statusFilter, calculates status for each contact and filters accordingly (overdue = nextDueDate < today, due soon = nextDueDate within 3 days, on track = nextDueDate > 3 days away). Sorts by nextDueDate ascending (soonest first). Builds table rows: for each contact, creates row with cells for name (clickable), company, tier badge (A=green, B=amber, C=gray), formatted lastContactDate, formatted nextDueDate, status pill (colored based on status), actions dropdown icon. Attaches click listeners to each row for viewing detail. Attaches listeners to actions dropdown. If no results, shows "No contacts found" empty state with graphic. Adds pagination if over 50 results.

- **showOutreachQueue()**: Calls showView('queue'). Calls loadQueueItems().

- **loadQueueItems()**: Retrieves renzo_queue from localStorage. Sorts by timestamp descending. For each queued item, creates card with contact name/company, tier badge, timestamp (formatDateTime), collapsible reason section (hidden by default, click to expand), message preview (first 80 chars + "..."), action buttons row. Attaches listeners: "Mark Sent" calls handleMarkSent(itemId), "Edit" calls openEditMessageModal(itemId), "Remove" calls removeFromQueue(itemId). If empty, shows empty state with helpful text and "Go to Contacts" button. Updates queue count badge in view header.

- **showDrafts()**: Calls showView('drafts'). Calls loadDraftItems().

- **loadDraftItems()**: Similar to loadQueueItems but retrieves renzo_drafts. Button labels are "Move to Queue" instead of "Mark Sent". "Move to Queue" calls moveDraftToQueue(itemId). Empty state text: "No drafts. Messages you skip or save for later will appear here."

- **showSettings()**: Calls showView('settings'). Loads current API key and displays masked (shows only last 4 chars). Loads company profile data and populates all form fields. Shows warning banner at top if renzo_api_key is empty or null. Attaches listener to "Test Connection" button. Attaches listener to "Save Settings" button.

### Contact Management

- **openAddContactForm()**: Shows modal overlay. Clears all form fields. Sets form mode to 'add'. Sets tier dropdown to default 'B'. Auto-fills touch frequency based on tier (A=7, B=30, C=90). Attaches listener to tier dropdown to update frequency on change. Attaches listener to Save button calling handleContactSave(). Attaches listener to Cancel button calling closeContactForm(). Focuses on name input.

- **openEditContactForm(contactId)**: Retrieves contact by ID from localStorage. Shows modal overlay. Populates all form fields with contact data. Sets form mode to 'edit'. Stores contactId in hidden field or data attribute. Attaches listener to Save button calling handleContactUpdate(contactId). Attaches listener to Cancel button calling closeContactForm(). Shows Delete button and attaches listener calling handleContactDelete(contactId). Focuses on name input.

- **handleContactSave()**: Validates required fields (name, company, tier). If validation fails, shows inline errors in red below each field and returns. Trims all text inputs. Creates contact object: {id: generateUUID(), name, company, title, email, phone, tier, touchFrequency, lastContactDate, nextDueDate: calculateNextDue(lastContactDate, touchFrequency), location, accountSize, products, relationshipHistory, notes, createdAt: Date.now(), updatedAt: Date.now()}. Retrieves existing contacts array from localStorage. Pushes new contact. Saves updated array to localStorage. Calls closeContactForm(). Calls loadContactsTable() to refresh view. Shows success toast message "Contact added successfully" for 3 seconds.

- **handleContactUpdate(contactId)**: Similar to handleContactSave but finds existing contact in array by ID. Updates all fields. Updates updatedAt timestamp. Recalculates nextDueDate if lastContactDate or touchFrequency changed. Saves updated array to localStorage. Shows success toast "Contact updated successfully".

- **handleContactDelete(contactId)**: Shows confirmation dialog "Are you sure you want to delete this contact? This action cannot be undone." If confirmed, retrieves contacts array, filters out contact with matching ID, saves updated array to localStorage. Also removes any queue/draft items associated with this contact. Calls closeContactForm(). Calls loadContactsTable(). Shows success toast "Contact deleted successfully".

- **closeContactForm()**: Hides modal overlay. Clears all form fields. Removes all event listeners attached to form. Resets form mode.

- **viewContactDetail(contactId)**: Retrieves contact by ID. Shows contact detail modal. Populates all contact fields in read-only format with proper labels. Displays tier badge and status pill at top. Loads activity history for this contact from renzo_activity (filters by contactId). Builds activity list with expandable items showing full messages. Attaches listener to "Edit Contact" button calling openEditContactForm(contactId). Attaches listener to "Generate Message" button calling openAIGenerationModal(contactId). Attaches listener to close/back button calling closeContactDetail().

- **closeContactDetail()**: Hides contact detail modal. Returns to contacts list view.

- **calculateNextDue(lastContactDate, touchFrequency)**: Converts lastContactDate string to Date object. Adds touchFrequency days. Returns new date in ISO format. If lastContactDate is empty, uses today's date as starting point.

- **getTierDescription(tier)**: Returns description string. A: "Weekly touchpoint, high-priority relationship", B: "Monthly touchpoint, regular account", C: "Quarterly touchpoint, low-frequency contact".

- **getStatusPill(contact)**: Calculates status based on nextDueDate. If nextDueDate < today: returns {class: 'status-overdue', text: 'Overdue', color: 'red'}. If nextDueDate within 3 days: returns {class: 'status-due-soon', text: 'Due Soon', color: 'amber'}. Else: returns {class: 'status-on-track', text: 'On Track', color: 'green'}. Used to build status pill HTML with appropriate color and text.

### AI Message Generation

- **openAIGenerationModal(contactId)**: Retrieves contact by ID. Shows AI generation modal overlay. Sets modal header "Generating Message for [Contact Name]". Shows loading state (spinner + "Analyzing relationship context..."). Hides result state initially. Calls generateAIMessage(contactId). Stores contactId in modal data attribute for later use.

- **generateAIMessage(contactId)**: Retrieves contact from localStorage. Retrieves company profile from localStorage. Validates API key exists; if not, shows error "Please add your Anthropic API key in Settings" and provides link to settings. Builds context prompt: includes company name, what they sell, rep name, communication tone, contact name, company, title, tier, location, account size, products they use, relationship history, notes, days since last contact, reason for touchpoint based on touch frequency (e.g., "It's been [X] days since your last touchpoint, and this is a [tier] contact requiring [frequency] check-ins"). Calls callAnthropicAPI(systemPrompt, userPrompt). On success, parses response JSON to extract {reason, message}. Updates modal to show result state. Populates "Why This Message" section with reason text. Populates message textarea with message text. Shows action buttons. On error, calls handleAPIError(error).

- **callAnthropicAPI(systemPrompt, userPrompt)**: Returns Promise. Makes fetch request to https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages. Sets headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-api-key': RENZO_API_KEY, 'anthropic-version': '2023-06-01', 'anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access': 'true'}. Body JSON: {model: 'claude-haiku-4-5', max_tokens: 400, system: systemPrompt, messages: [{role: 'user', content: userPrompt}]}. Awaits response. If not ok, throws error with response.statusText. Parses response JSON. Returns content[0].text. Catches and throws any errors for handling upstream.

- **buildSystemPrompt(companyProfile)**: Returns string: "You are an AI assistant helping [companyName] maintain professional relationships. [CompanyName] sells: [whatYouSell]. Your typical customers are: [typicalCustomer]. Write outreach messages in a [commTone] tone, as if from [repName]. Always return valid JSON with two fields: 'reason' (2 sentences explaining the context and why this message now) and 'message' (3-5 sentence outreach message that references past conversations if available)."

- **buildUserPrompt(contact, daysSince, touchReason)**: Returns string: "Generate an outreach message for [name] at [company]. Title: [title]. Tier: [tier] ([tier description]). Location: [location]. Account Size: [accountSize]. They use: [products]. Relationship history: [relationshipHistory]. Notes: [notes]. It's been [daysSince] days since last contact. [touchReason]. Create a message that feels personal, references past context where available, and provides value."

- **handleRegenerateMessage()**: Gets contactId from modal data attribute. Shows loading state again. Calls generateAIMessage(contactId) with same parameters. Replaces result when new generation completes. Increments generation attempt counter (max 5 per session to prevent API abuse).

- **handleAddToQueue()**: Gets contactId, reason, and message from modal. Creates queue item object: {id: generateUUID(), contactId, contactName, contactCompany, tier, reason, message, timestamp: Date.now()}. Retrieves renzo_queue from localStorage. Pushes new item. Saves to localStorage. Calls closeAIGenerationModal(). Shows success toast "Message added to queue". If called from dashboard due contacts list, updates that contact's nextDueDate to today (marking as "handled" even though not sent yet).

- **handleAddToDrafts()**: Similar to handleAddToQueue but saves to renzo_drafts instead. Used when user wants to save without committing to queue.

- **closeAIGenerationModal()**: Hides modal overlay. Clears loading/result states. Resets form. Removes event listeners.

- **handleAPIError(error)**: Logs error to console. Hides loading state. Shows error state in modal with user-friendly message. If error.status === 401: "Invalid API key. Please check your settings." If error.status === 429: "Rate limit exceeded. Please try again in a moment." If error includes 'network': "Network error. Please check your connection." Else: "Failed to generate message. Please try again." Shows "Retry" button calling generateAIMessage again. Shows "Cancel" button calling closeAIGenerationModal.

### Queue & Drafts Management

- **handleMarkSent(queueItemId)**: Shows confirmation "Mark this message as sent?". If confirmed, retrieves queue item by ID. Retrieves associated contact by contactId. Creates activity log entry: {id: generateUUID(), contactId, contactName, contactCompany, message, reason, timestamp: Date.now(), action: 'message_sent', repName: currentUser.repName}. Appends to renzo_activity in localStorage. Updates contact's lastContactDate to today. Recalculates and updates contact's nextDueDate using calculateNextDue(). Saves updated contact. Removes item from renzo_queue. Saves updated queue. Calls loadQueueItems() to refresh view. Shows success toast "Message marked as sent". Increments "Sent This Week" counter if still current week.

- **handleBulkMarkSent()**: Shows confirmation "Mark all [count] messages as sent?". If confirmed, retrieves entire queue. Iterates through each item calling handleMarkSent() logic for each. Batches localStorage saves for performance. Shows progress indicator if over 10 items. On completion, refreshes queue view and shows success toast "All messages marked as sent".

- **openEditMessageModal(queueItemId)**: Retrieves queue item by ID. Shows edit modal with message in textarea. Keeps reason visible but read-only. Allows editing message text. Attaches Save listener that updates message in queue item and saves to localStorage. Attaches Cancel listener that closes without saving.

- **removeFromQueue(queueItemId)**: Shows confirmation "Remove this message from queue?". If confirmed, retrieves renzo_queue, filters out item with matching ID, saves updated array. Calls loadQueueItems(). Shows success toast "Message removed from queue".

- **moveDraftToQueue(draftItemId)**: Retrieves draft item by ID. Removes from renzo_drafts array. Adds to renzo_queue array with updated timestamp. Saves both arrays to localStorage. Calls loadDraftItems() to refresh drafts view. Shows success toast "Draft moved to queue".

- **removeDraft(draftItemId)**: Shows confirmation "Delete this draft?". If confirmed, removes from renzo_drafts. Saves to localStorage. Refreshes view. Shows toast.

### Settings Management

- **handleSaveSettings()**: Gets API key value (trims whitespace). Validates not empty and looks like valid key format (starts with 'sk-'). Gets all company profile field values. Validates required fields. Creates companyProfile object. Saves to localStorage as renzo_company_profile. Saves API key to localStorage as renzo_api_key. Updates global RENZO_API_KEY variable. Hides warning banner if it was shown. Shows success message "Settings saved successfully" in green for 3 seconds. If API key changed, suggests testing connection.

- **handleTestAPIConnection()**: Gets API key value. Shows loading spinner on button ("Testing..."). Calls callAnthropicAPI with simple test prompt (system: "You are a test assistant", user: "Respond with just 'OK'"). If successful, shows green checkmark and "Connection successful" message. If fails, shows red X and error message from handleAPIError. Resets button after 3 seconds.

- **toggleAPIKeyVisibility()**: Toggles API key input type between 'password' and 'text'. Updates toggle button icon from eye to eye-slash and vice versa.

### Utility Functions

- **generateUUID()**: Returns unique identifier string using crypto.randomUUID() if available, else falls back to timestamp-based UUID generation: 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx' with random hex replacements.

- **formatDate(dateString)**: Converts ISO date string to readable format "Jan 15, 2024". Handles invalid dates gracefully by returning original string.

- **formatDateTime(timestamp)**: Converts Unix timestamp to "Jan 15, 2024 3:45 PM" format. Uses 12-hour time with AM/PM.

- **escapeHTML(str)**: Escapes HTML special characters to prevent XSS. Replaces &, <, >, ", ' with their HTML entity equivalents. Returns safe string for innerHTML insertion.

- **debounce(func, delay)**: Returns debounced version of function that only executes after delay milliseconds have passed since last call. Used for search input to avoid excessive filtering on every keystroke.

- **showToast(message, type = 'success')**: Creates temporary toast notification element. Styles based on type ('success' = green, 'error' = red, 'info' = blue). Positions fixed at top center of screen. Shows for 3 seconds then fades out and removes from DOM. Queues multiple toasts vertically if shown simultaneously.

- **confirmDialog(message)**: Returns Promise. Shows custom modal confirmation dialog with message text, "Confirm" and "Cancel" buttons. Resolves promise with true if Confirm clicked, false if Cancel. More styled than native confirm().

- **calculateDaysAgo(date)**: Takes date string, calculates difference between that date and today in days. Returns integer. Used for "X days ago" displays.

- **getTierColor(tier)**: Returns color hex code based on tier. A: '#2D6A4F' (brand green), B: '#F59E0B' (amber), C: '#6B7280' (gray). Used for tier badge backgrounds.

- **getTierLabel(tier)**: Returns full label. A: 'A-Tier', B: 'B-Tier', C: 'C-Tier'. Used for accessibility and clear labeling.

- **validateEmail(email)**: Uses regex to validate email format. Returns boolean. Pattern: /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/

- **validatePhone(phone)**: Flexible validation, allows various formats. Strips non-numeric characters and validates length between 10-15 digits. Returns boolean.

- **sortContacts(contacts, sortBy, direction = 'asc')**: Takes contacts array and sorts by specified field (name, company, nextDueDate, lastContactDate, tier). Direction can be 'asc' or 'desc'. Returns sorted array. Used for table column sorting.

- **filterContacts(contacts, filters)**: Takes contacts array and filters object {search, tier, status}. Applies all filters cumulatively. Returns filtered array. Case-insensitive string matching for search.

- **getRelativeTimeString(timestamp)**: Converts timestamp to relative string like "2 hours ago", "3 days ago", "just now". Used for activity feed timestamps when recent.

- **initializeDefaultData()**: Called on first app load if localStorage is empty. Creates sample contacts array with 3-5 example contacts showing different tiers and statuses. Saves to localStorage. Creates empty arrays for queue, drafts, activity. Shows onboarding to set up company profile.

---

## DATA STORAGE

### LocalStorage Keys and Structures

**renzo_session**: Object
```
{
  username: string (currently only 'admin'),
  loginTime: number (Unix timestamp),
  repName: string (user's name for message attribution)
}
```

**renzo_onboarded**: Boolean
- true if user has completed onboarding, false or absent if not

**renzo_company_profile**: Object
```
{
  companyName: string,
  whatYouSell: string (2-3 sentence description),
  typicalCustomer: string (who they are, what they care about),
  commTone: string (one of: 'Professional', 'Conversational', 'Direct', 'Warm'),
  repName: string (who messages come from)
}
```

**renzo_api_key**: String
- Anthropic API key, stored in plain text (user is warned about security)

**renzo_contacts**: Array of contact objects
```
[
  {
    id: string (UUID),
    name: string (required),
    company: string (required),
    title: string,
    email: string (validated format),
    phone: string,
    tier: string (required, one of: 'A', 'B', 'C'),
    touchFrequency: number (days between touches, default by tier: A=7, B=30, C=90),
    lastContactDate: string (ISO date format 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
    nextDueDate: string (ISO date format, calculated from lastContactDate + touchFrequency),
    location: string (region/city),
    accountSize: string (one of: 'Small', 'Mid-Market', 'Large', 'Enterprise'),
    products: string (products/services they use, multi-line text),
    relationshipHistory: string (past conversations, key topics, who spoke with them),
    notes: string (any other relevant information),
    createdAt: number (Unix timestamp),
    updatedAt: number (Unix timestamp)
  }
]
```

**renzo_queue**: Array of queued message objects
```
[
  {
    id: string (UUID),
